_doc: Install-check corpus: the top 200 npm + top 200 PyPI packages by AgentAvow adoption (install-check requests, 2026-10-14), pinned to one version with the scripts/corpus/build_manifest resolvers (same archive choice as production). npm sha256 pins were added after verifying each tarball against the registry's sha512 integrity. Archives are verified by sha256 and NEVER executed or installed. Run nightly with scripts/corpus/run_install_check_corpus.py; the gate fails when a label moves vs expected.json.
